summary: Phase 2 CRM & Sales Management end-to-end verified. Backend: 27/27 new Phase 2 tests + 23/23 Phase 1 regression tests all PASS (50/50 total). Frontend: All acceptance flows work end-to-end - Sales A creates customer, opens Customer 360, schedules follow-up (appears in timeline), creates lead in NEW column, moves stage via move-stage-<id> dropdown (persists after reload); Sales B cannot see A's customers (list=0) and gets customer360-forbidden page on direct nav; Super Admin sees all customers/leads (data_scope=all); /hpp shows Forbidden for Sales and HPP not in Sales sidebar; Sales Dashboard shows exactly 10 KPI cards + 5 Quick Actions; Global Search returns customers/leads and clicking result navigates to Customer 360. Phase 1 regression (login/logout, User Mgmt page, Audit log) still works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1216 lines - close to the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into modules (auth, users, crm, sales, hpp, settings) for maintainability as Phase 3 grows.

Backend RBAC ownership properly enforced via owner_filter() and can_access_record() at every /customers, /leads, /follow-ups endpoint. Verified via pytest that Sales B receives empty list + 403 on Sales A's data.

Lead 'stage' is stored in the 'status' field (backend model) but the API and frontend refer to 'stage' in PATCH body - consistent and working, but slightly confusing naming. Consider renaming for clarity in Phase 3.
Global Search endpoint requires 'crm.view' permission - correctly blocks Accounting (verified 403).
Timeline records activities: lead_created, stage_change, follow_up_created, follow_up (completion), note, communication - all appearing in Customer 360 Timeline tab as expected.
Sales /hpp direct navigation shows Forbidden page AND GET /api/hpp returns 403 - both frontend and backend guarded.
Minor: Some Radix Dialog console warnings still absent in this run - previous a11y warning about DialogDescription is resolved in Phase 2 dialogs (all use DialogDescription).
